page.content:
Tathagata who pins Wukong and grants the scriptures at the end.

How Buddha connects

  • Character: Sun Wukong — The Buddha wins the wager and pins Wukong under the mountain.
  • Location: Thunderclap Monastery — The Buddha grants the texts at Thunderclap Monastery.
  • Location: Five Elements Mountain — The mountain is the Buddha's palm made stone.

What is Buddha?

The Buddha of Thunderclap outwits Wukong on the palm-as-mountain wager, imprisons him for five hundred years, and is the giver of the Tripitaka texts that close the book.

Key threads lead to Sun Wukong, Thunderclap Monastery and Five Elements Mountain.
